answer: Every claim climbs the lotus of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the comet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on verifiable delay functions interleaved with localized peer attestation quorums. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the oasis of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short.
